description.value: Atomic Bike Shop is a repair-first bicycle shop in Vancouver, situated at the south end of the Granville Bridge and celebrating 20 years in business. Operated by a specialist named Steve, it handles everything from road and mountain bikes to BMX, cargo, and folding bikes with a focus on quality workmanship over retail sales. Touring cyclists will find a full repair and tune-up service, custom builds, and the ability to have bikes boxed up for travel.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 15m; stands (5 spaces) at 39m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fetchable and confirms the OSM address (1555 West 6th Ave, Vancouver, BC V6J 1R1) and phone (604.714.0158). The services page explicitly states the shop is 'dedicated specifically to repairs rather than traditional retail sales' and lists assembly/boxing for travel, confirming bike box/packing capability. The 'currently open' banner uses COVID-era social-distancing language, and the copyright reads 2017, raising concerns that the website is significantly outdated and may not reflect current operations.
concerns: Website copyright reads 2017 and has not been updated in years; 'currently open' banner uses COVID-era social-distancing language, so current hours and operating policies are unverifiable.
OSM name is 'Atomic Bike Shop' but website page titles consistently read 'Atomic Bikeshop' (no space) — minor branding inconsistency.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, long-established repair-focused bike shop in Vancouver with confirmed contact details and clear value for touring cyclists needing mechanical help or bike boxing. Recommend verifying current operations given the dated website.
enrichment_extras.notes: The shop carries a small stock of accessories (pedals, locks, tires, tools) and can order parts not on hand. Specialises in DH and freeride but services a wide range of bike types including cargo and folding.

Bike boxes / packing.detail: Services page states: 'We can also safely box up bikes for travel.'

wow_evidence: repair-first…20 years in business…bikes boxed up for travel
